ds:450:516:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Got any idea how I should handle the next meet?
ds:450:516:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]下次見面，我該怎麼辦，有什麼點子嗎？

ds:450:517:Dialogue Text.source: Well she’s a lot more than I was expecting!
ds:450:517:Dialogue Text.target: 嗯，她比我預料的，厲害多了！

ds:450:519:Dialogue Text.source:
How do you feel about it? Do you like
her taking control? Or did you want to
have some power in the exchange?
ds:450:519:Dialogue Text.target:
你自己的感覺呢？喜歡讓她掌控？
還是，你也想在互動裡，
掌握一點主導權？

ds:450:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm… Y’know, I could go either way!

ds:450:521:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think I usually end up being in control most of the time, so it’s kinda nice to be hands off for once.
ds:450:521:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]我想，平常多半都是我掌控，所以，難得一次不用主導，感覺還不錯。

ds:450:522:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was her toy, and I kinda dug it.
ds:450:522:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我成了她的玩具，而我還挺喜歡。

ds:450:523:Dialogue Text.source:
Sounds like you should
just enjoy the ride!
ds:450:523:Dialogue Text.target:
聽起來，你就該
好好享受這一切！

ds:450:525:Dialogue Text.source:
Do you know when
you’re meeting up next?
ds:450:525:Dialogue Text.target:
知道下次，
什麼時候見面嗎？

ds:450:526:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I don’t… but I have a feeling it’ll be pretty soon…
ds:450:526:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]不知道……不過，我有種感覺，應該很快……

ds:451:758:Dialogue Text.source: In a passionate tangle, makin’ out.
ds:451:758:Dialogue Text.target: 熱情地糾纏在一起，吻得難分難捨。

ds:451:759:Dialogue Text.source: It was messy, it was primal.
ds:451:759:Dialogue Text.target: 濕漉漉的，充滿原始慾望。

ds:451:762:Dialogue Text.target: 接著，事情開始變得重口味……

ds:451:764:Dialogue Text.source: Before I knew it, she had me all tied up!
ds:451:764:Dialogue Text.target: 還沒回過神，她就把我綁得動彈不得！

ds:451:765:Dialogue Text.source: Spread out, and DANG was she teasin’ me.
ds:451:765:Dialogue Text.target: 四肢攤開，靠，她可真會逗我。

ds:451:766:Dialogue Text.source: She’d go back and forth from lickin’ and fondling with her paws.
ds:451:766:Dialogue Text.target: 一下舔，一下又換爪子愛撫，來來回回。

ds:451:768:Dialogue Text.source: Then she’d come up and give me a huge wet kiss.
ds:451:768:Dialogue Text.target: 接著，她又靠過來，給我一個大大的濕吻。

ds:451:769:Dialogue Text.source: We’d make out a bit, and then I noticed… As things started heating up, she’d slow down…
ds:451:769:Dialogue Text.target: 我們熱吻了一會兒，接著我發現……每次越來越火熱，她就會慢下來……

ds:451:770:Dialogue Text.source: And she’d go back and forth, getting me reaaaaallly excited, then easing off!
ds:451:770:Dialogue Text.target: 她就這樣反反覆覆，把我弄得超～～興奮，再停一停！

ds:451:771:Dialogue Text.source: Now, I’m no stranger to edging, so I knew her game…
ds:451:771:Dialogue Text.target: 高潮控制，我也不陌生，所以知道她在玩什麼把戲……

ds:451:774:Dialogue Text.source: I noticed she untied one of my hands…
ds:451:774:Dialogue Text.target: 我發現，她解開了我一隻手……

ds:451:775:Dialogue Text.source: And then I realized she was just walking off!
ds:451:775:Dialogue Text.target: 然後才發現，她居然就要走了！

ds:451:777:Dialogue Text.source: Right? She lapped at her paws while giving me a cheeky grin.
ds:451:777:Dialogue Text.target: 對吧？她一邊舔著自己的爪子，一邊對我露出調皮的笑容。

ds:451:778:Dialogue Text.source: And as she slipped away she said, "Not on the first date." AND THEN SHE WAS GONE!
ds:451:778:Dialogue Text.target: 她溜走時，還說：「第一次約會不行。」然後就消失了！

ds:451:780:Dialogue Text.source: She left me high and dry! Well… not really dry…
ds:451:780:Dialogue Text.target: 她把我晾在那裡，晾得乾乾的！嗯……也沒有真的乾……

ds:451:781:Dialogue Text.target: 不過，真的把我吊在那兒！

ds:451:785:Dialogue Text.source: As she was walking off, I saw her tail was absolutely dripping.
ds:451:785:Dialogue Text.target: 她走掉的時候，我看到她尾巴都濕得直滴了。

ds:451:786:Dialogue Text.source: She was teasing herself as much as she was teasing me!
ds:451:786:Dialogue Text.target: 她不只在逗我，也同樣在逗自己！

ds:451:789:Dialogue Text.source: I think she wants me to NOT cum until we meet again.
ds:451:789:Dialogue Text.target: 我想，她是要我忍住，等下次見面才能射。

ds:451:793:Dialogue Text.source: Red, buddy, as soon as she was gone, I cranked myself silly!
ds:451:793:Dialogue Text.target: 小紅，老兄，她一走，我就擼得天翻地覆！

ds:451:794:Dialogue Text.source: I didn’t even untie the other straps, just cranked one out right there.
ds:451:794:Dialogue Text.target: 連其他綁帶都沒解，就直接在那裡擼一發。

ds:451:796:Dialogue Text.source: It was a big load too! Her loss!
ds:451:796:Dialogue Text.target: 而且還射了一大堆！算她的損失！

ds:452:701:Dialogue Text.source: The coyotes mentioned something about Excursions?
ds:452:701:Dialogue Text.target: 郊狼提過，什麼「遠足」的事？

ds:452:702:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Excursions huh? Is that what they call it?

ds:452:703:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Darling, it’s just some booty calls with some friends on the other side of the forest.
ds:452:703:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]親愛的，就只是跟森林另一邊的朋友，約個炮。

ds:452:704:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But yeah, sometimes the girls and I would go out with some other critters.
ds:452:704:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]不過，對，有時候，我和姑娘們，會跟其他小動物一起出去。

ds:452:706:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Rebecka a gorgeous dark hen, and Marygold, a real sweet heart doe.
ds:452:706:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]對啊！蕾貝卡，一位漂亮的深色母雞，還有瑪莉戈德，一位甜美的母鹿。

ds:452:707:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Usually it’s just us gals, but, I bet they wouldn’t mind a guy crashing ladies night…
ds:452:707:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]平常，只有我們姑娘，不過，我賭，她們不介意，姊妹之夜，多個男人來攪局……

ds:452:710:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be making a trip out there in a bit actually. Are you good to go?
ds:452:710:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]其實，過一會兒，我就要去一趟。你能出發嗎？

ds:452:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I see. Ok, next time it is.

ds:452:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well Rascal, looks like you held your own with the gals.
ds:452:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]拉斯卡爾，看來，你應付那些姑娘，挺有一套。

ds:452:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They can be a little much to new comers…
ds:452:719:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]對新來的人，她們有時，有點太熱情……

ds:452:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They absolutely loved you, I can tell.
ds:452:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]她們可愛死你了，我看得出來。

ds:452:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be sure to let you know when the next hang out is. Er- "Excursion."
ds:452:724:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]下次聚會，一定會通知你。呃——「遠足」。

ds:453:658:Dialogue Text.source: *Rascal and Melody make their way to an open meadow. They join a group of critters at a bed of flowers*
ds:453:658:Dialogue Text.target: *拉斯卡爾和梅洛蒂來到一片開闊的草地，走向花叢旁的一群小動物*

ds:453:660:Dialogue Text.source: Melodyyyy who is this cute lil stud? Is he gonna be our toy for the day?
ds:453:660:Dialogue Text.target: 梅洛蒂～～，這可愛的小猛男是誰？今天要給我們當玩具嗎？

ds:453:664:Dialogue Text.source: Ladies, ladies! Don’t sound so desperate, heavens!
ds:453:664:Dialogue Text.target: 女士們，女士們！天啊，別說得那麼飢渴！

ds:453:666:Dialogue Text.source: Hey that’s all Becka! She’s the thirsty one!
ds:453:666:Dialogue Text.target: 嘿，那都是貝卡！飢渴的是她！

ds:453:668:Dialogue Text.source: That’s right! Thirsty and proud! Bok bok!
ds:453:668:Dialogue Text.target: 沒錯！就是飢渴，我還很驕傲呢！咯咯！

ds:453:670:Dialogue Text.source: The name’s Rascal! I’m here to quench your thirst!
ds:453:670:Dialogue Text.target: 我叫拉斯卡爾！專程來替妳解渴！

ds:453:672:Dialogue Text.source: D’ohoho! Quite the silver tongue on this fella! Where didja find this critter Melody?
ds:453:672:Dialogue Text.target: 喔呵呵！這傢伙的嘴真甜！梅洛蒂，妳去哪裡找到他的？

ds:453:674:Dialogue Text.source: He’s new on the other side of the forest. He’s been helping Charlotte and I out.
ds:453:674:Dialogue Text.target: 他是森林另一邊的新朋友，一直在幫我和夏洛特的忙。

ds:453:675:Dialogue Text.source: So I figured I could treat him to a fun day with the gals!
ds:453:675:Dialogue Text.target: 所以我想，請他跟女孩們一起玩個開心，就當是犒賞！

ds:453:677:Dialogue Text.target: 是犒賞他，還是犒賞我們啊？

ds:453:679:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, two birds with one stone! Er, no offense…
ds:453:679:Dialogue Text.target: 呵，一石二鳥嘛！呃，沒有冒犯的意思……

ds:453:681:Dialogue Text.source: None taken so long as I get first dibs! Let me at him!
ds:453:681:Dialogue Text.target: 不介意，只要讓我先來就好！快把他交給我！

ds:453:687:Dialogue Text.source: Tag me in when you’re finished!

ds:453:688:Dialogue Text.source: *Rascal and Becka make their way to a nearby clearing…*
ds:453:688:Dialogue Text.target: *拉斯卡爾和貝卡走向附近的一片空地……*

ds:453:690:Dialogue Text.source: So, you ever get it on with a bird before?
ds:453:690:Dialogue Text.target: 所以，你以前跟鳥類做過嗎？

ds:453:692:Dialogue Text.source: I have not! But I’m familiar with what goes on down there.
ds:453:692:Dialogue Text.target: 還沒有！不過，我知道妳們下面是怎麼回事。

ds:453:694:Dialogue Text.source: Great, I don’t have to teach you then!
ds:453:694:Dialogue Text.target: 很好，那我就不用教你了！

ds:453:695:Dialogue Text.source: Don’t be shy now, grab me by the hips and go to town!
ds:453:695:Dialogue Text.target: 別害羞，抓住我的腰，盡情來吧！

ds:453:697:Dialogue Text.source: You don’t need a warm up?

ds:453:699:Dialogue Text.target: 不用，相信我，我準備好了。

ds:453:704:Dialogue Text.source: Oh damn Rascal, you’re packin’! Bok!
ds:453:704:Dialogue Text.target: 喔，靠，拉斯卡爾，你可真有本錢！咯！

ds:453:715:Dialogue Text.source: I-… Did I just go in a different hole?
ds:453:715:Dialogue Text.target: 我……剛剛是不是進了另一個洞？

ds:453:717:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm~ Yeah, ah~ Don’t worry about it…

ds:453:718:Dialogue Text.source: In fact… feel free to- nnnf switch it up…
ds:453:718:Dialogue Text.target: 其實……你可以——嗯呋，隨意換著來……

ds:453:723:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, hey Rascal. Do me a favor?
ds:453:723:Dialogue Text.target: 嗯，嘿，拉斯卡爾，幫我個忙？

ds:453:727:Dialogue Text.source: Pull out and make me a mess.
ds:453:727:Dialogue Text.target: 拔出來，把我弄得亂七八糟。

ds:453:731:Dialogue Text.source: I wanna show the gals. Plus, Melody will clean me right up…
ds:453:731:Dialogue Text.target: 我想秀給女孩們看。而且，梅洛蒂會幫我清乾淨……

ds:453:734:Dialogue Text.source: I’m about to lose it anyway!

ds:453:739:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh, what a pent up guy!

ds:453:741:Dialogue Text.source: Heh… I can be quite… productive.

ds:453:743:Dialogue Text.source: I’ll say! This is perfect. I’ll send Merrygold over next!
ds:453:743:Dialogue Text.target: 可不是嘛！太完美了。下一個，我會叫瑪莉戈德過來！

ds:453:744:Dialogue Text.target: 等我的腿不再發抖再說……

ds:453:745:Dialogue Text.source: *Some time passes and Marygold pops her head out of a nearby bush*
ds:453:745:Dialogue Text.target: *過了一段時間，瑪莉戈德從附近的灌木叢裡探出頭*

ds:453:747:Dialogue Text.source: Hey Rascal… You really gave it to Becka huh?
ds:453:747:Dialogue Text.target: 嘿，拉斯卡爾……你可真把貝卡弄得夠嗆，對吧？

ds:453:748:Dialogue Text.source: She was a mess! I bet that was her idea.
ds:453:748:Dialogue Text.target: 她全身都是！我猜一定是她的主意。

ds:453:750:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! She said she wanted Melody to clean her up.
ds:453:750:Dialogue Text.target: 對啊！她說想讓梅洛蒂幫她清理。

ds:453:753:Dialogue Text.source: Well Rascal… I’ve got a bit of a request myself…
ds:453:753:Dialogue Text.target: 嗯，拉斯卡爾……我自己也有個小小的請求……

ds:453:757:Dialogue Text.source: First, let’s see what we’re workin’ with…
ds:453:757:Dialogue Text.target: 首先，先來看看我們有些什麼……

ds:453:761:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm… I can still taste Becka on you…
ds:453:761:Dialogue Text.target: 嗯……你身上還嚐得到貝卡的味道……

ds:453:762:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, both holes? I bet that was her idea too…
ds:453:762:Dialogue Text.target: 嗯，兩個洞都玩了？我猜那也是她的主意……

ds:453:767:Dialogue Text.source: Here’s my little kink… I like it when my partner is in their throes of passion, and they get rough.
ds:453:767:Dialogue Text.target: 我有個小性癖……我喜歡伴侶沉浸在激情裡，動作變得粗魯。

ds:453:771:Dialogue Text.source: Don’t worry, I’m a big gal, I can take it!
ds:453:771:Dialogue Text.target: 別擔心，我可是大個子女生，承受得住！

ds:453:772:Dialogue Text.source: Just get lost in the moment, don’t worry about me~
ds:453:772:Dialogue Text.target: 盡情沉浸在當下，別擔心我～

ds:453:775:Dialogue Text.source: Well, I am getting pretty close…

ds:453:789:Dialogue Text.source: *She nods as her tail wags wildly*

ds:453:791:Dialogue Text.source: Alright… Well I’m not gonna last long with you doing whatever you’re doing there…
ds:453:791:Dialogue Text.target: 好……妳這樣弄……我可撐不了太久了……

ds:453:800:Dialogue Text.source: Ahhh hah… Just a lil… more…

ds:453:808:Dialogue Text.source: Let me, hah… catch my breath…

ds:453:810:Dialogue Text.source: Sorry, was I holding you down?
ds:453:810:Dialogue Text.target: 抱歉，我剛才把妳壓住了嗎？

ds:453:812:Dialogue Text.source: Just a bit. But I could easily have yanked away if I wanted.
ds:453:812:Dialogue Text.target: 有一點。不過，我想掙開的話，輕輕鬆鬆就辦得到。

ds:453:813:Dialogue Text.source: But that’s what I love to see… What my partner does when they are in the moment…
ds:453:813:Dialogue Text.target: 可是，我就是喜歡看這個……伴侶忘情時，會做出什麼反應……

ds:453:814:Dialogue Text.source: You seem to lose control of those claws
ds:453:814:Dialogue Text.target: 你好像會控制不住那雙爪子。

ds:453:816:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah… I was… trying to be rough? I don’t know this is my first time.
ds:453:816:Dialogue Text.target: 對啊……我剛剛……想試著粗魯一點？我也不知道，這是第一次。

ds:453:818:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, yeah that’s ok! It was cute, and does more for me than you know…
ds:453:818:Dialogue Text.target: 哈哈，沒關係！很可愛，而且帶給我的感覺，比你知道的還多……

ds:453:820:Dialogue Text.source: So can I like… I dunno spank you and help you finish? or…?
ds:453:820:Dialogue Text.target: 所以，我能不能……不知道，打打妳的屁股，幫妳高潮？還是……？

ds:453:823:Dialogue Text.source: It’s actually hard for me to finish with new partners. Just another quirk of mine.
ds:453:823:Dialogue Text.target: 其實，跟新伴侶在一起，我很難高潮。就是我的另一個小怪癖。

ds:453:824:Dialogue Text.source: I was just here to have some fun with you~!
ds:453:824:Dialogue Text.target: 我只是來跟你開心玩玩的～！

ds:453:826:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! Okay well rain check then!

ds:453:828:Dialogue Text.source: Sounds good. Let’s head back, I could use a snack!
ds:453:828:Dialogue Text.target: 好啊，回去吧，我想吃點點心！

ds:453:830:Dialogue Text.source: I wasn’t filling enough for you?

ds:453:832:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal, that was fun, but you’re like, thirty pounds.
ds:453:832:Dialogue Text.target: 拉斯卡爾，剛才很好玩，可是你大概才三十磅重。

ds:453:837:Dialogue Text.source: *Rascal and Marygold make their way back to Melody and Rebecka*
ds:453:837:Dialogue Text.target: *拉斯卡爾和瑪莉戈德回到梅洛蒂與蕾貝卡身邊*

ds:453:840:Dialogue Text.source: Great timing, I just got Rebecka all cleaned up.
ds:453:840:Dialogue Text.target: 時間剛剛好，我才剛幫蕾貝卡清乾淨。

ds:453:842:Dialogue Text.target: 下面可乾淨了，簡直清到吱吱叫！

ds:453:844:Dialogue Text.source: Yes darling, someone certainly was squeaking, that’s for sure…
ds:453:844:Dialogue Text.target: 是啊，親愛的，確實有人吱吱叫，這點我很肯定……

ds:453:847:Dialogue Text.source: Definitely a keeper! We’re going to have to fool around again real soon!
ds:453:847:Dialogue Text.target: 絕對值得留著！我們很快就得再玩一次！

ds:453:848:Dialogue Text.source: But uh… I could do with a bite to eat…

ds:453:853:Dialogue Text.source: *The critters spend the rest of the evening with food and drink, before making their way back home.*
ds:453:853:Dialogue Text.target: *小動物們一邊吃喝，度過了晚間剩下的時光，然後各自回家。*

ds:454:133:Dialogue Text.source: You used to date some bears?
ds:454:133:Dialogue Text.target: 你以前跟一些熊交往過？

ds:454:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]我就愛，那些抱起來舒服的男人！

ds:454:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]They’re STRONG too! Some of those guys can really take charge!
ds:454:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]力氣也大！有些傢伙，真能好好掌控全場！

ds:454:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Say Rascal, would you want to meet some of my friends?
ds:454:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]欸，拉斯卡爾，要不要認識一下，我的幾位朋友？

ds:454:141:Dialogue Text.source: Oh do you still meet with them?
ds:454:141:Dialogue Text.target: 噢，你現在，還會跟他們見面？

ds:454:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We’ll do occasional romps here and there.
ds:454:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]偶爾，會在這裡、那裡，一起玩一場。

ds:454:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s been a little bit, so I’m sure they’ll be happy to see me!
ds:454:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]有一陣子沒見了，我想，他們一定很高興看到我！

ds:454:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And they are quite the welcoming bunch, I’m sure they’d love to have ya!
ds:454:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]而且，他們都很好客，我相信，也會很歡迎你！

ds:454:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Ok, let me get a hold of these fellas, I’ll be right back!
ds:454:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]好，我去聯絡那幾個傢伙，馬上回來！

ds:454:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Whew! Those guys sure are somethin’ eh?

ds:458:322:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]真好，我卻老是被這些懶洋洋搭便車的纏上！

ds:458:323:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Y’all got legs, don’tcha? Bahaw just messin’, dear!
ds:458:323:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]你們不是都有腿嗎？嘎哈，開玩笑的，親愛的！

ds:458:328:Dialogue Text.source:
The sign reads: Ring the bell!
Now, if you only had a bell…
ds:458:328:Dialogue Text.target:
告示牌寫著：「搖鈴！」
要是你有個鈴就好了……

ds:458:335:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Each of the bells are in their own key and ring out a specific jingle that helps me figure out where you are! See, sounds echo quite aimlessly up in the sky, so this helps speed up the process!
ds:458:335:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]每個鈴的調性都不同，會響起特定的短曲，幫我判斷你在哪裡！因為聲音在空中四處迴盪，沒個準頭，這樣就能加快找到你的速度！

ds:458:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I only offer pick up and drop off at the designated perches! It’s all part of the terms and services! (also apparently emergency rescue services…)
ds:458:336:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]我只在指定的降落點提供接送！這都是服務條款的一部分！（顯然還附帶緊急救援服務……）

ds:458:337:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Finally, by riding Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom you accept any and all accidental damages that can happen and may result in permanent damage, and or death!
ds:458:337:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]最後，搭乘「佩妮・羽翎，載你飛不停」，就代表你接受一切可能發生的意外傷害，包括永久損傷，甚至死亡！

ds:458:338:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]不過，還沒發生過就是了。*眨眼*

ds:458:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]OK With that all out of the way, where would you like to go?
ds:458:339:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]好啦，該說的都說完了，你想去哪裡？

ds:458:341:Dialogue Text.source: Player can only choose the Central Forest
ds:458:341:Dialogue Text.target: Player can only choose the Central Forest

ds:458:347:Dialogue Text.source: Player can only choose the Central Forest
ds:458:347:Dialogue Text.target: Player can only choose the Central Forest

ds:458:353:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I bet you’re wondering what’s with this bell you rang, eh?
ds:458:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]我猜你一定在想，剛才搖的這個鈴是怎麼回事吧？

ds:458:355:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See, I run a little business here! Would you like to hear my lil’ spiel?
ds:458:355:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]是這樣的，我在這裡做點小生意！想聽聽我的小小介紹嗎？

ds:458:358:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Welcome to Penny Plume’s, Ride and Zoom!
ds:458:358:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]歡迎搭乘「佩妮・羽翎，載你飛不停」！

ds:458:359:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The name’s Penny, as you know, and I’ll be your flight attendant today!
ds:458:359:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]你也知道，我叫佩妮，今天將由我為你提供空中服務！

ds:458:360:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… And every other day. I’m the only one who works at Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom.
ds:458:360:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]……其他日子也是。「佩妮・羽翎，載你飛不停」就只有我一個員工。

ds:458:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me explain how it works! I’ve given these bells to everyone in the forest, and when a critter needs a ride, they can ring the bell and I’ll pick them up!
ds:458:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]讓我解釋一下吧！我把這些鈴分給了森林裡的每個人，小動物們需要搭便車時，只要搖響鈴，我就會去接他們！

ds:458:362:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She can go mama-bear sometimes, but she means well.
ds:458:362:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]她有時會像護犢子的熊媽媽一樣，不過都是一片好意。

ds:458:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Trust me, I’ve had my fair share of scolds from her!

ds:458:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh! Looks like we’re here! Hold on tight!

ds:458:367:Dialogue Text.source: Uh, Yeah! … Sorry, do I know you?
ds:458:367:Dialogue Text.target: 呃，對啊！……不好意思，我們認識嗎？

ds:458:368:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You probably weren’t conscious at the time… but I was the one who found you.
ds:458:368:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]那時你可能已經失去意識了……不過，是我發現你的。

ds:458:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was flying my normal routes, and I saw you collapsed on the ground!
ds:458:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我正沿著平常的路線飛，就看到你倒在地上！

ds:458:371:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I didn’t know how to help, so I took you to Scarlett immediately.
ds:458:371:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我不知道怎麼幫你，就立刻把你送到史嘉蕾那裡。

ds:458:372:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve been busy working, so I couldn’t stop by to see how you were doing. It’s been plaguing me all day!
ds:458:372:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我一直忙著工作，沒辦法去看看你怎麼樣。這件事讓我整天掛心！

ds:458:373:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I’m so happy to see you are doing ok!
ds:458:373:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]不過，看到你沒事，我真是太開心了！

ds:458:374:Dialogue Text.target: 多虧了妳，我才能沒事啊！

ds:458:375:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Baww, no worries dear. Again, just glad to see you’re okay.
ds:458:375:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]哎呀，別客氣，親愛的。還是那句，看到你沒事就好。

ds:458:377:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know if this is too much for you right now! I know you might not be feeling well.
ds:458:377:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]如果現在這樣讓你吃不消，就告訴我！我知道你可能還不太舒服。

ds:458:380:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh look, that’s the clearing where I found you.
ds:458:380:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]噢，你看，那就是我發現你的空地。

ds:458:382:Dialogue Text.source: … I, uh… Didn’t get a lot of sleep…

ds:458:384:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hah! I’m guessing Scarlett gave you an earful already?
ds:458:384:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]哈！我猜史嘉蕾已經好好唸過你一頓了？

ds:458:421:Dialogue Text.source: Penny is on a date right now! Better try again later.
ds:458:421:Dialogue Text.target: 佩妮現在正在約會！還是晚點再試吧。

ds:458:425:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All this glowing glyph business has been super exciting!
ds:458:425:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]這些發光的文字符號，可真讓人興奮！

ds:458:428:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good things actually! I think they’re becoming more curious about it.
ds:458:428:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]其實是好事！我想，大家對這件事越來越好奇了。

ds:458:431:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I feel like things are just beginning!

ds:459:435:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So how’s your stay been so far?
ds:459:435:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]所以，到目前為止，住得怎麼樣？

ds:459:438:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Lots of folks seem to enjoy being busy, but personally, I like the slower pace of things…
ds:459:438:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]很多人似乎喜歡忙忙碌碌，不過，我個人喜歡慢一點的步調……

ds:459:439:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh gosh, maybe I’m just getting old!

ds:459:440:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Aaand here we are! Please remain seated while we begin our descent!
ds:459:440:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]到——了！開始下降時，請留在座位上！

ds:459:442:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Bahaw! I hear you’ve been running some errands!
ds:459:442:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]嘎哈！聽說你最近跑了些差事！

ds:459:443:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The folks are keeping you busy, eh?

ds:459:444:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t worry, that means they like ya!

ds:459:447:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Though… We might be coming up on some turbulence…

ds:459:451:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Look’s like we’re here though, prepare to descend!
ds:459:451:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]不過，看來我們到了，準備下降！

ds:459:454:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This is your fourth trip with me. How do you like flying?
ds:459:454:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]這是你第四次搭乘了。覺得飛行怎麼樣？

ds:459:455:Dialogue Text.source:
It’s actually incredible!
The sights are magnificent.
ds:459:455:Dialogue Text.target:
其實很不可思議！
景色太壯觀了。

ds:459:456:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Right? It’s crazy to think! There’s SO MUCH space up here!
ds:459:456:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]對吧？想想真不得了！這上面的空間多大啊！

ds:459:457:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a shame only us flyin’ folk can appreciate it.
ds:459:457:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]可惜，只有我們會飛的，才能欣賞。

ds:459:458:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m so glad I can share it with you critters!
ds:459:458:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]能和你們這些小動物分享，我真開心！

ds:459:459:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! Here we are! Prepare for landing!

ds:459:460:Dialogue Text.source:
Still pretty scary…
And your jokes don’t help!
ds:459:460:Dialogue Text.target:
還是挺可怕的……
而且妳的玩笑一點幫助都沒有！

ds:459:461:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Baww! Hah! That’s tough love for ya, Rascal!
ds:459:461:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]哎呀！哈！這叫嚴厲的愛，拉斯卡爾！

ds:459:462:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, most of us birds learn how to fly by FALLING. A LOT!
ds:459:462:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]你知道嗎，我們大多數的鳥，都是靠摔下去學會飛的。摔很多次！

ds:459:463:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gotta rip off that bandaid, y’know? Only then will you see that things aren’t so scary!
ds:459:463:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]總得一口氣撕掉那塊貼布，你懂吧？這樣才會發現，事情沒那麼可怕！

ds:459:464:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Besides, the jokes are a complementary service! Those aren’t goin’ anywhere, bahaw!
ds:459:464:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]再說，笑話可是免費附贈的服務！可不會取消，嘎哈！

ds:459:466:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Y’know, I’ve been seeing you a lot today…
ds:459:466:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]你知道嗎，今天常常見到你呢……

ds:459:467:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Normally I don’t see the same critter more than twice a day…
ds:459:467:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]平常，同一位小動物，我一天不會見到超過兩次……

ds:459:468:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Not that I mind of course! I’ll ferry your cute rump all day long!
ds:459:468:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]當然，我不介意！你這可愛的小屁股，我可以載上一整天！

ds:459:469:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh gosh, don’t tell my boss I’m flirting with you! Bahaw!
ds:459:469:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]噢，天啊，別告訴我老闆，我在跟你調情！嘎哈！

ds:459:473:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Right? I hear the flight attendant isn’t half bad lookin’ either!
ds:459:473:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]對吧？聽說，這裡的空服員也挺好看的！

ds:459:475:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Must be nice, I keep gettin’ stuck with these lazy free loaders!
ds:459:475:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]真好，我卻老是被這些懶洋洋搭便車的纏上！

ds:459:476:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Y’all got legs, don’tcha? Bahaw just messin’, dear!
ds:459:476:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]你們不是都有腿嗎？嘎哈，開玩笑的，親愛的！

ds:459:481:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All this glowing glyph business has been super exciting!
ds:459:481:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]這些發光的文字符號，可真讓人興奮！

ds:459:484:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good things actually! I think they’re becoming more curious about it.
ds:459:484:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]其實是好事！我想，大家對這件事越來越好奇了。

ds:459:487:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I feel like things are just beginning!

ds:459:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Have you ever been up this high?
ds:459:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]你以前到過這麼高的地方嗎？

ds:459:722:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Don’t you worry dear, I’ve never dropped a critter before.
ds:459:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]別擔心，親愛的，我從沒把小動物摔下去過。

ds:459:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Poor old Fred, he was a good bun…
ds:459:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]可憐的老弗瑞德，他是隻好兔子……

ds:459:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]BAHAWHAW Just kidding! You’ll be fine dear!
ds:459:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]嘎哈哈哈，開玩笑的！你不會有事，親愛的！

ds:459:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh and look! Here is your stop!

ds:459:729:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll take it you’re trembling from excitement then!
ds:459:729:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]那我就當你是興奮得發抖囉！

ds:459:731:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Most critters nearly piss themselves from fear their first time!
ds:459:731:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]大多數的小動物，第一次幾乎都嚇到尿褲子！

ds:459:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh uh, don’t worry, I thoroughly wash after those incidents.
ds:459:732:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]噢，呃，別擔心，每次出那種事以後，我都有徹底清洗。

ds:459:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]你可是我的第一個客人……有史以來……

ds:459:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve been doing these flights long before you were born.
ds:459:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]你還沒出生以前，我就在跑這些航線了。

ds:459:742:Dialogue Text.source: During flights. Penny will talk to you about random various things. I’ll include a list of stuff she’ll go through, but this first one will be scripted. After a certain amount of flights you can unlock her scene. Also maybe you need to be in like, act 3 or something.
ds:459:742:Dialogue Text.target: During flights. Penny will talk to you about random various things. I’ll include a list of stuff she’ll go through, but this first one will be scripted. After a certain amount of flights you can unlock her scene. Also maybe you need to be in like, act 3 or something.

ds:45:131:Dialogue Text.source: A crib. Looks like it hasn’t been used for a while.
ds:45:131:Dialogue Text.target: 一張嬰兒床。看來有陣子沒用過了。

ds:460:422:Dialogue Text.source: Penny is on a date right now! Better try again later.
ds:460:422:Dialogue Text.target: 佩妮現在正在約會！還是晚點再試吧。

ds:462:20:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Y'know Red, I think we're gonna be real good friends!
ds:462:20:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]小紅，我覺得我們一定會成為很好的朋友！

ds:462:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Can't wait to show you the shop, Red! You're gonna love it!
ds:462:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]等不及帶你看看店裡了，小紅！你一定會喜歡！

ds:462:26:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]... And I will love your patronage...

ds:463:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Just messin’, you’re welcome here any time.

ds:463:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, you’re not pulling some elaborate prank on us with all the shenanigans going on, right?
ds:463:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]嘿，小紅，最近這些亂七八糟的事，不是你精心策劃來整我們的吧？

ds:463:758:Dialogue Text.source:
It is known that Red Pandas
can control the weather!
ds:463:758:Dialogue Text.target:
眾所周知，小熊貓
可以控制天氣！

ds:464:422:Dialogue Text.source: Penny is busy elsewhere! Better try again later.
ds:464:422:Dialogue Text.target: 佩妮在別處忙著！還是晚點再試吧。

ds:465:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ah, then forgive me but I must cut this short.

ds:465:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]夏洛特真的很不喜歡暴風雨。

ds:465:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh? Ok, well it’s a wrap anyhow. Let’s see what’s going on out there.
ds:465:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]喔？好吧，反正也拍完了。出去看看是怎麼回事吧。

ds:466:740:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=1]Thanks a ton for playing our game!


And thanks EVEN MORE for reporting some bugs!
ds:466:740:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=1]非常感謝，你來玩我們的遊戲！


更要感謝，你幫忙回報錯誤！

ds:466:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We recently rebuilt the game into a 2.0 version.
ds:466:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]我們最近，把遊戲重做成2.0版本。

ds:466:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It wasn't easy, and it'll allow for a lot of exciting things in the future.
ds:466:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]過程並不容易，不過，也讓未來，有了許多令人期待的可能。

ds:466:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So it's possible there might be some bugs...

ds:466:748:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=6]So...

That’s why we could use your help-
ds:466:748:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=6]所以……

我們才需要你的幫忙——

ds:466:749:Dialogue Text.source: *Screen goes black* *Glitch Rascal flashes in [pic=8]* *Maybe we glitch out the dialogue for Glitch Rascal?*
ds:466:749:Dialogue Text.target: *Screen goes black* *Glitch Rascal flashes in [pic=8]* *Maybe we glitch out the dialogue for Glitch Rascal?*

ds:466:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Kidding. Of course I did that. That guy was getting on my nerves.
ds:466:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]開玩笑。當然是我。那傢伙，吵得我心煩。

ds:466:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]So what’s the deal here, you sit there and push some buttons, watch some critters fuck?
ds:466:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]所以，這是怎麼回事，你就坐在那裡，按幾個按鈕，看些小動物打炮？

ds:466:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]So just before you got here, you were typing on a terminal.
ds:466:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]你剛來這裡之前，是在終端機上打字吧。

ds:466:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I need you to type something in.

ds:466:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Don’t you think I’d have done it if I could?
ds:466:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]我要是辦得到，難道不早就做了？

ds:466:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]No more questions. Just type this in the terminal.
ds:466:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]別再問了。照這樣，輸入終端機。

ds:466:764:Dialogue Text.source: *Glitch Rascal will glitch out* *Screen returns to white, and normal rascal is back*
ds:466:764:Dialogue Text.target: *Glitch Rascal will glitch out* *Screen returns to white, and normal rascal is back*

ds:466:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So let us know if anything weird comes up while playing!
ds:466:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]所以，玩的時候，發現什麼怪事，記得告訴我們！

ds:466:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Say… You kinda look like you just saw a ghost or something…
ds:466:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]欸……你看起來，好像剛見了鬼還是什麼……

ds:466:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]So if I, make this guy cum.
ds:466:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]所以，要是我，讓這傢伙射出來。

ds:466:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]You’d get a kick out of it?

ds:466:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I need you to do something, if you can figure it out, I’ll have some fun with this guy, and you can watch.
ds:466:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]我要你做件事，要是辦得到，我就跟這傢伙玩玩，讓你看。

ds:466:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well maybe put the game down for a bit and get some fresh air.
ds:466:781:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]那，也許先放下遊戲一下，去透透氣。

ds:466:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Who am I? Maybe a better question is what am I.
ds:466:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]我是誰？也許，該問的，是我是什麼。

ds:466:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]But I have decided, I’m getting tired of your questions.
ds:466:790:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]不過，我倒是決定了，我開始受夠你的問題了。

ds:466:813:Dialogue Text.source: *Glitch Rascal appears and overrides* *BG is black*
ds:466:813:Dialogue Text.target: *Glitch Rascal appears and overrides* *BG is black*

ds:466:815:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]I see you haven’t figured it out yet…

ds:466:816:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Did you need me to repeat it again?

ds:466:819:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Ok fine. But pay attention this time.

ds:466:820:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]一字不差地，把這個輸入終端機。

ds:466:825:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So what, did ya just want to say hi?

ds:466:826:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Aren’t you supposed to be reporting some bugs or something?
ds:466:826:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]你不是應該在回報錯誤，還是什麼的嗎？

ds:466:827:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, I should get back to it.

ds:466:855:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But the changes touched almost every line of code...
ds:466:855:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]可是，這次改動，幾乎動到了每一行程式碼……

ds:467:741:Dialogue Text.source: I can still leave you in the shop.
ds:467:741:Dialogue Text.target: 我還可以把妳留在店裡。

ds:467:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Don’t you dare! Let’s go, critters need our help!
ds:467:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]你敢！快走，小動物們需要我們幫忙！

ds:467:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Could these have flown from his place?

ds:467:748:Dialogue Text.source: It’s possible! This wind is pretty nuts!

ds:467:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Let’s keep an eye out for more.

ds:467:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]We can hand them back to him after this all settles down!
ds:467:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]等風雨平息，我們就能拿去還他！

ds:467:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]I think I saw several more papers flying about...
ds:467:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]我好像看到還有好幾張紙在飛...

ds:467:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Let's get them and get out of here!

ds:467:791:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]I think I saw one more page flying about...

ds:467:792:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Let's grab it and get out of here!

ds:467:793:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Ok, looks like we got all the papers flying about.
ds:467:793:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]好，看來飛來飛去的紙，我們都撿到了。

ds:467:794:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]I did see another one stuck at the rock house next to Scarlett's!
ds:467:794:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]不過我還看到一張卡在史嘉蕾家旁邊的石屋那裡！

ds:467:795:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]We can nab it and then crash at their place.
ds:467:795:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]我們拿到後，就到他們家歇著吧。

ds:467:800:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Let's grab those papers and get out of here!
ds:467:800:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]撿起那些紙，就趕快離開這裡吧！

ds:467:806:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7] Rascal, I'm getting pretty dang cold... Let's grab that paper by the rocks and get outa this storm!
ds:467:806:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7] 拉斯卡爾，我快冷死了……拿到石頭旁邊那張紙，就趕快離開這場暴風雨吧！

ds:468:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah, Melody just left in a huge hurry.
ds:468:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]對啊，梅洛蒂剛剛急急忙忙地走了。

ds:468:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Apparently Charlotte’s not crazy about stormy weather.
ds:468:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]聽說夏洛特不太喜歡暴風雨。

ds:468:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well you two are welcome to shack up with me. It’s nice and cozy in here.
ds:468:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]你們兩個想留在我這裡避一避，隨時歡迎。裡面舒服又暖和。

ds:468:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It… kinda looks like they need help?

ds:468:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Peter and Scarlett are messing with a tarp… and I see Bucky’s doing something with his house…?
ds:468:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]彼得跟史嘉蕾在弄一塊防水布……我還看到巴奇在他家那邊忙著做什麼……？

ds:468:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It doesn’t look like either are going well…

ds:468:756:Dialogue Text.source: That doesn’t sound like a good idea.

ds:468:758:Dialogue Text.source: *Mabel ties a string around her to you.*
ds:468:758:Dialogue Text.target: *梅貝爾用一條繩子把自己跟你綁在一起。*

ds:468:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Despite that seeming like a really dumb idea.
ds:468:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]雖然這看起來真是個蠢主意。

ds:468:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I can personally vouch for that string. Mabel isn’t going anywhere with that baby attached.
ds:468:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]但那條繩子，我可以親自掛保證。有那寶貝綁著，梅貝爾哪也飛不走。

ds:468:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Plus, I’m sure she will be quite helpful!
ds:468:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]而且，我相信她也能幫上大忙！

ds:468:763:Dialogue Text.source:
What? She’s so small!
Why don’t you come help?
ds:468:763:Dialogue Text.target:
什麼？她那麼小！
你怎麼不來幫忙？

ds:468:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well… I’m not too crazy about storms either Red…
ds:468:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]嗯……小紅，我也不太喜歡暴風雨……

ds:468:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I don’t want to get struck by lightning…

ds:468:766:Dialogue Text.source: You won’t get struck by lightning.

ds:468:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You don’t know that Red! My cousin? Struck by lightning, twice!
ds:468:767:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]小紅，你又不知道！我有個堂表親，就被雷劈過，還兩次！

ds:468:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Now he walks all funny! I don’t wanna walk all funny!
ds:468:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]現在他走路都怪怪的！我才不要走路怪怪的！

ds:468:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Guys, we don’t have time for this.

ds:468:770:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, as soon as I untie this string.

ds:468:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Not happening, look at this knot. You can’t untie this.
ds:468:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]不可能，看看這個結。你解不開的。

ds:469:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal! Thank goodness you’re here. Please give us a hand!
ds:469:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]拉斯卡爾！謝天謝地，你來了。快幫我們一把！

ds:469:741:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to black, replace art with fixed Tarp*
ds:469:741:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to black, replace art with fixed Tarp*

ds:469:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Actually, I think I hear someone calling for help.
ds:469:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]等等，我好像聽到有人在求救。

ds:469:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Whoa Mabel? What are you doing here? You need to get inside!
ds:469:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]哇，梅貝爾？妳在這裡做什麼？妳得進屋才行！

ds:469:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]No time! Looks like Dustin is waving us over! He’s on the other side of the river!
ds:469:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]沒時間了！好像是達斯汀在招手叫我們過去！他在河對岸！

ds:469:747:Dialogue Text.source: Don’t worry, she hasn’t gotten swept away yet.
ds:469:747:Dialogue Text.target: 別擔心，她還沒被捲走呢。

ds:469:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You two better get back here AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

ds:46:131:Dialogue Text.source: Quite comfortable! Looks like there is room for two?
ds:46:131:Dialogue Text.target: 挺舒服的！看起來能睡兩個人？

ds:470:204:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like a perch for a bird. It has been heavily used. There’s a sign nearby that reads Ring the bell!
ds:470:204:Dialogue Text.target: 看起來是鳥用的降落點，經常使用的痕跡很明顯。旁邊有塊告示牌，寫著「搖鈴！」

ds:473:742:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve got it. What’s going on?

ds:473:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]He’s been repairing it, but he needs someone applying force with this stick.
ds:473:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]他一直在修，可是需要有人用這根棍子施力撐著。

ds:473:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Bucky will pop up from the water soon, he’ll let you know what you have to do!
ds:473:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]巴奇很快就會從水裡冒出來，他會告訴你該怎麼做！

ds:473:747:Dialogue Text.source:
Ok, I’ll manage it!
You should get somewhere safe.
ds:473:747:Dialogue Text.target:
好，我來處理！
你先找個安全的地方吧。

ds:473:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]We’ll keep the door open for you.

ds:473:750:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s ok, I’ll be at Scarlett and Peter’s
once we’re done here.
ds:473:750:Dialogue Text.target:
沒關係，這邊忙完，
我會去史嘉蕾和彼得家。

ds:473:752:Dialogue Text.source: *Maybe he acknolwedges Mabel? Kinda unecessary but fun*
ds:473:752:Dialogue Text.target: *Maybe he acknolwedges Mabel? Kinda unecessary but fun*

ds:473:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Is that Mabel? What are you doing out here?
ds:473:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]……那是梅貝爾？妳在這裡做什麼？

ds:473:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hm… That’s a nice tether you got there…

ds:473:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Got any more? I can help out too.

ds:473:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gotcha. Well then I’ll get out of your hair.

ds:474:778:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to black and dustin will leave. Or he’ll animate zipping off. Shortly after, Bucky will appear*
ds:474:778:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to black and dustin will leave. Or he’ll animate zipping off. Shortly after, Bucky will appear*

ds:474:779:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]喔！嘿，拉斯卡爾。這天氣可真夠嗆，對吧？

ds:474:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m glad you’re here! Dustin was not cutting it. He’s like, ten pounds soaking wet. He could barely hold that thing in place! Let alone apply pressure to it.
ds:474:781:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]你來真是太好了！達斯汀實在撐不住。他全身濕透，大概也才十磅重，光是固定住那東西都勉強，更別說出力壓住了！

ds:474:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, so here’s how it’s gonna work.

ds:474:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m gonna go under here and pop up inside near you. When I give you the signal you’re going to apply A LOT of pressure!
ds:474:783:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]我會從這裡潛下去，再到裡面靠近你的位置浮上來。等我給你信號，你就要用非常大的力氣往下壓！

ds:474:784:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Really put your back into it! Give it everything you got!
ds:474:784:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]真的要使出吃奶的力氣！全力以赴！

ds:474:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Whoa whoa! Too soon! Gotta wait for me!

ds:474:792:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ooh, just a bit late there! Try to keep up!

ds:474:793:Dialogue Text.source: **Once the player succeeds, advance them to level 2**
ds:474:793:Dialogue Text.target: **Once the player succeeds, advance them to level 2**

ds:474:794:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]太好了！第一個小地方修好了。

ds:474:795:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This one might be a bit trickier… But same thing! Wait for my mark…
ds:474:795:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]這次可能比較難……不過做法一樣！等我的信號……

ds:474:796:Dialogue Text.source: **Once the player succeeds, advance them to level 3**
ds:474:796:Dialogue Text.target: **Once the player succeeds, advance them to level 3**

ds:474:798:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]There’ll be two moments this time! And it’s a bit of a doozy, so keep an eye out!
ds:474:798:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]這次有兩個時機點！而且有點難纏，要注意看！

ds:474:800:Dialogue Text.source: **Once the player succeeds it’s done** *Bucky will resurface*
ds:474:800:Dialogue Text.target: **Once the player succeeds it’s done** *Bucky will resurface*

ds:474:802:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Good work! I’m gonna get out of here.

ds:474:803:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You’re welcome to take shelter at my place! Come on around!

ds:474:804:Dialogue Text.target: 我沒問題的，不過還是謝謝你！

ds:474:805:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You're sticking around out here? It's getting pretty dangerous!
ds:474:805:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]你還要待在外面？已經越來越危險了！

ds:474:806:Dialogue Text.source:
I saw some documents flying around.
I'll nab them and get out of here.
ds:474:806:Dialogue Text.target:
我看到有些文件被吹得滿天飛。
撿到就會離開了。

ds:474:808:Dialogue Text.source: No I’m good, you should get inside!
ds:474:808:Dialogue Text.target: 不用，我可以，你先進屋吧！

ds:475:739:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, this is getting pretty intense!

ds:475:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Let's scope out those rocks, maybe we can wait out the storm there!
ds:475:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]去看看那些石頭吧，也許能在那裡等風雨過去！

ds:475:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Oh man, it's really coming down now!

ds:476:741:Dialogue Text.source: *Glitch Rascal appears and overrides* *BG is black*
ds:476:741:Dialogue Text.target: *Glitch Rascal appears and overrides* *BG is black*

ds:476:746:Dialogue Text.source: Well, I held up my end of the deal…

ds:476:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just wanted to thank you guys for giving our game a shot, and taking the time to report a bug!
ds:476:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]只是想謝謝大家，願意試玩我們的遊戲，還花時間，回報錯誤！

ds:476:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]As you may know, we recently rebuilt the game into a 2.0 version.
ds:476:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]你可能也知道，我們最近，把遊戲重做成2.0版本。

ds:476:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It wasn’t easy, and the process touched almost every line of code!
ds:476:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]過程並不容易，而且，幾乎動到了每一行程式碼！

ds:476:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So we’re super grateful to get the extra eyes to look over potential bugs that slipped through the cracks!
ds:476:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]所以，能多幾雙眼睛，幫忙找出漏網的潛在錯誤，我們真的非常感激！

ds:476:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So let us know if anything weird comes up while playing!
ds:476:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]所以，玩的時候，發現什麼怪事，記得告訴我們！

ds:476:819:Dialogue Text.source: *Flash to image 16*  (make the background like, 20% less black)
ds:476:819:Dialogue Text.target: *Flash to image 16*  (make the background like, 20% less black)

ds:476:822:Dialogue Text.source: *Flash to image 17* (make the background like, 50% less black)
ds:476:822:Dialogue Text.target: *Flash to image 17* (make the background like, 50% less black)

ds:476:824:Dialogue Text.source: *FLash to image 18*  (make the background like 75 less black%)
ds:476:824:Dialogue Text.target: *FLash to image 18*  (make the background like 75 less black%)

ds:476:828:Dialogue Text.source: So uh… Was that a glitch or a feature?
ds:476:828:Dialogue Text.target: 所以，呃……那到底是錯誤，還是功能？

ds:476:829:Dialogue Text.source: *Glitch to black* *Unlock scene* *Start the game over again? Just go back to bug report? I dunno*
ds:476:829:Dialogue Text.target: *Glitch to black* *Unlock scene* *Start the game over again? Just go back to bug report? I dunno*

ds:476:831:Dialogue Text.target: 你一定很希望這就是你的吧……

ds:476:833:Dialogue Text.source: That’s the question, now isn’t it?
ds:476:833:Dialogue Text.target: 這就是問題所在，不是嗎？

ds:476:834:Dialogue Text.source: Now shutup and lay down, I want a ride.
ds:476:834:Dialogue Text.target: 現在，閉嘴，躺好，我想騎一騎。

ds:477:755:Dialogue Text.source: So… How do we do this?

ds:477:759:Dialogue Text.source: Ooh, getting hard already, are we?

ds:477:761:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s give this guy a taste…

ds:477:764:Dialogue Text.source: I can’t believe you’re getting this much in there…
ds:477:764:Dialogue Text.target: 真不敢相信，妳竟然能含進去這麼多……

ds:477:770:Dialogue Text.source: Your throat… God damn that’s tight!

ds:477:774:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh yeah, where does it all go?

ds:477:778:Dialogue Text.source: Well yeah! I’m a leaky faucet down here!
ds:477:778:Dialogue Text.target: 當然！我下面就像漏水的水龍頭！

ds:477:779:Dialogue Text.source: You want me to like, eat you out… or like a finger?
ds:477:779:Dialogue Text.target: 妳想讓我舔妳……還是用手指？

ds:477:780:Dialogue Text.source: No no, I’ve got something else in mind…

ds:477:783:Dialogue Text.source: It’s always pretty hot watching a dude clean up his mess…
ds:477:783:Dialogue Text.target: 看男生清理自己的傑作，總是很火辣……

ds:477:784:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, it’s definitely funner licking it off of a cute lady!
ds:477:784:Dialogue Text.target: 哈哈，從可愛的女士身上舔乾淨，確實好玩多了！

ds:477:788:Dialogue Text.source: Now put me down on your dick.
ds:477:788:Dialogue Text.target: 現在，把我放到你的屌上。

ds:477:789:Dialogue Text.source: What! That’s not going to fit.
ds:477:789:Dialogue Text.target: 什麼！那不可能塞得進去。

ds:477:794:Dialogue Text.source: Come on I can take it!

ds:477:797:Dialogue Text.source: Come on man, put some muscle in it!

ds:477:798:Dialogue Text.source: Getting it to pop in is the hard part, but I can do it, trust me.
ds:477:798:Dialogue Text.target: 讓它擠進去，才是最難的部分。不過我辦得到，相信我。

ds:477:801:Dialogue Text.source: Ok ok! Maybe… if I just… move your legs up here…
ds:477:801:Dialogue Text.target: 好好！也許……只要把……妳的腿往這邊抬……

ds:477:802:Dialogue Text.source: Oh…? Ok, here we are… I think this might actually-
ds:477:802:Dialogue Text.target: 喔……？好，有了……搞不好真的能——

ds:477:804:Dialogue Text.source: Is this hurting? Should I stop?

ds:477:805:Dialogue Text.target: 哈啊，不會不會，你做得好～～。

ds:477:808:Dialogue Text.source: Whoa! Okay! Well look at that! You got the tip in.
ds:477:808:Dialogue Text.target: 哇！好！看看這個！妳把前端吃進去了。

ds:477:809:Dialogue Text.target: 哈哈，那不算什麼，看好了。

ds:477:810:Dialogue Text.source: *She starts wiggling further down Rascal’s shaft*
ds:477:810:Dialogue Text.target: *她開始扭動著，沿拉斯卡爾的肉棒往下滑得更深*

ds:477:811:Dialogue Text.source: Hooooo boy… Okay, that’s a lot further than I thought this would go.
ds:477:811:Dialogue Text.target: 喔，天啊……好，這可比我想的深太多了。

ds:477:824:Dialogue Text.source: Hahahaaa. Y’know… For once I’m glad someone didn’t last too long.
ds:477:824:Dialogue Text.target: 哈哈。你知道嗎……難得有人沒撐太久，我反而很高興。

ds:477:825:Dialogue Text.source: That was DEFINITELY a lot to handle.

ds:477:826:Dialogue Text.source: I didn’t hurt you, did I?

ds:477:827:Dialogue Text.source: There’s always a bit of pain with this sort of sizeplay.
ds:477:827:Dialogue Text.target: 這種體型差玩法，總是會有一點痛。

ds:477:828:Dialogue Text.source: Ahhh… It’s good we took things slow…

ds:477:829:Dialogue Text.source: It’s also good I’m a total bad ass.
ds:477:829:Dialogue Text.target: 也還好，我厲害得不得了。

ds:477:833:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, and it doesn’t look like this rain is letting up any time soon…
ds:477:833:Dialogue Text.target: 對，而且這雨，看來也不會很快停……

ds:477:835:Dialogue Text.source: Cuddle up with me! I’m gonna get cold!

ds:477:837:Dialogue Text.source: I’m telling ya, I’m quite experienced!

ds:477:839:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I need you to help me loosen up more.
ds:477:839:Dialogue Text.target: 好，我需要你幫忙，讓我再鬆開一點。

ds:477:840:Dialogue Text.source: Grab me and bob me up and down. Slowly!
ds:477:840:Dialogue Text.target: 抓住我，讓我上下起伏。慢慢地！

ds:477:843:Dialogue Text.source: Ahhhh-Oh, don’t let it pop out!

ds:477:845:Dialogue Text.source: Mmmm… I can’t believe you’re taking all this…
ds:477:845:Dialogue Text.target: 嗯……真不敢相信，妳吃得下這麼多……

ds:477:851:Dialogue Text.source: This doesn't play in the gallery version:
ds:477:851:Dialogue Text.target: This doesn't play in the gallery version:

ds:477:852:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh, where on earth did all this come from?
ds:477:852:Dialogue Text.target: 天啊，這一切到底是從哪裡冒出來的？

ds:477:853:Dialogue Text.source: Do you guys get storms this bad normally?
ds:477:853:Dialogue Text.target: 你們平常也有這麼嚴重的暴風雨嗎？

ds:477:854:Dialogue Text.source: We can get some serious snow, we've gotten wind storms, we've gotten hail, but this is kinda crazy.
ds:477:854:Dialogue Text.target: 有時候雪會下很大，也有過狂風、冰雹，可是這次有點誇張。

ds:477:855:Dialogue Text.source: ... Where are we anyways? Do you know who lived here?
ds:477:855:Dialogue Text.target: ...話說，我們到底在哪裡？妳知道誰住過這裡嗎？

ds:477:856:Dialogue Text.source: No, this structure hasn't had an owner since as long as I can remember.
ds:477:856:Dialogue Text.target: 不知道，從我有記憶以來，這建築就沒有主人。

ds:477:857:Dialogue Text.source: It seems pretty sturdy on the inside. I think we'll be ok here.
ds:477:857:Dialogue Text.target: 裡面看起來挺牢固，我想待在這裡應該沒問題。

ds:477:866:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like we have some time to kill...
ds:477:866:Dialogue Text.target: 看來，我們有些時間得打發...

ds:478:422:Dialogue Text.source: It's much too dangerous for Penny to fly in this weather! Better try again later.
ds:478:422:Dialogue Text.target: 這種天氣，佩妮飛行太危險了！還是晚點再試吧。

ds:479:754:Dialogue Text.source: Ok ok, I’m up, I’m up.

ds:479:755:Dialogue Text.source: It’s all clear outside. Looks like the storm passed.
ds:479:755:Dialogue Text.target: 外面都放晴了，看來暴風雨過去了。

ds:479:757:Dialogue Text.source: So… <waitfor=0.5>Last night was pretty crazy, right?

ds:479:758:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, I still can’t believe I fit in you.
ds:479:758:Dialogue Text.target: 對，還是不敢相信，我竟然塞得進妳裡面。

ds:479:759:Dialogue Text.source: No not that part. <waitfor=0.5>I meant the weather. <waitfor=0.5>Something didn’t feel right…
ds:479:759:Dialogue Text.target: 不是，不是那個。<waitfor=0.5>我是說天氣。<waitfor=0.5>感覺有哪裡不對勁……

ds:479:760:Dialogue Text.source: As much as I hate to say it, I think my Mom might be on to something…
ds:479:760:Dialogue Text.target: 雖然很不想承認，可是我想，我媽可能真的知道些什麼……

ds:479:763:Dialogue Text.source: I guess I should start by saying my family isn’t quite like most critters around here.
ds:479:763:Dialogue Text.target: 我想，應該先說，我家的人跟這裡大部分的小動物不太一樣。

ds:479:764:Dialogue Text.source: They’ve got a different set of beliefs, ones that I don’t really agree with…
ds:479:764:Dialogue Text.target: 他們有另一套信仰，那些我不太認同……

ds:479:765:Dialogue Text.source: But more recently, well… <waitfor=0.5>I don’t know. <waitfor=0.5>The glowing runes, <waitfor=0.5>the storm - <waitfor=0.5>I just wonder what they have to say about all this.
ds:479:765:Dialogue Text.target: 可是，最近，嗯……<waitfor=0.5>我不知道。<waitfor=0.5>發光的符文，<waitfor=0.5>暴風雨——<waitfor=0.5>就是想知道，他們對這一切會怎麼說。

ds:479:766:Dialogue Text.source: Would you be interested in coming along?

ds:479:768:Dialogue Text.source: Sweet. We live in the deep woods, pretty far in.
ds:479:768:Dialogue Text.target: 太好了，我們住在幽深林地，還挺深的地方。

ds:479:769:Dialogue Text.source: It’s pretty dang dark in there…

ds:479:770:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, it’s not so bad once you know the way… <waitfor=0.5>But you’re right, we should probably get you a light.
ds:479:770:Dialogue Text.target: 對，認得路後，就沒那麼糟……<waitfor=0.5>不過你說得對，應該先幫你找個照明的東西。

ds:479:771:Dialogue Text.source: We often use Fireflies to light the way. <waitfor=0.5>We could gather some up in a jar. It would work!
ds:479:771:Dialogue Text.target: 我們常用螢火蟲照路。<waitfor=0.5>可以拿玻璃罐裝一些，這樣就行！

ds:479:772:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s check with the other critters. Someone probably has a lantern or something.
ds:479:772:Dialogue Text.target: 先問問其他小動物吧，應該有人有提燈之類的。

ds:479:773:Dialogue Text.source: Hah yeah, that’s probably a better idea.
ds:479:773:Dialogue Text.target: 哈，對，這主意大概比較好。

ds:479:774:Dialogue Text.source: We could check up on the rest of the critters while we’re at it!
ds:479:774:Dialogue Text.target: 也能順便看看，其他小動物過得怎麼樣！

ds:47:132:Dialogue Text.source: The drawers and cabinets are very well stocked.
ds:47:132:Dialogue Text.target: 抽屜和櫥櫃裡的東西備得很齊全。

ds:480:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal! That was some storm, huh?
ds:480:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]嘿，拉斯卡爾！這場暴風雨可真不得了，對吧？

ds:480:743:Dialogue Text.source: Do you get storms like this often?
ds:480:743:Dialogue Text.target: 這種暴風雨常常發生嗎？

ds:480:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m glad Charlotte and Melody let me shack up while it was blowing over.
ds:480:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]還好夏洛特和梅洛蒂讓我留下來，等風雨過去。

ds:480:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]隨時都可以，親愛的，永遠歡迎你！

ds:481:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]各位早啊！好大一場暴風雨，對吧？

ds:481:742:Dialogue Text.source: It was! Ever see something like that?
ds:481:742:Dialogue Text.target: 是啊！你以前見過這種陣仗嗎？

ds:481:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That bad of a storm? Yeah sure!

ds:481:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve been all over, so that wasn’t my first rodeo.
ds:481:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]我到處跑過，這可不是頭一遭。

ds:481:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I once ran a race during a storm like that. Half the contestants dropped out, but that didn’t stop me!
ds:481:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]我還曾經在這種暴風雨裡賽跑。一半的選手都退出了，可是我沒有被打倒！

ds:481:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]不會，不過你們本地人比較清楚。

ds:481:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Maverick sure was acting up though! Kept going on and on about his cousin getting hit by lightning.
ds:481:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]倒是馬弗瑞克大驚小怪的！一直說個不停，說他有個堂表親被雷劈過。

ds:482:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]<size=18>Oh thank heavens you two are ok!</size>

ds:482:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]When you guys didn’t show up, we were worried sick!
ds:482:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]你們一直沒來，害我們擔心得要命！

ds:482:742:Dialogue Text.source: Ah y-yeah… Other critters needed help…
ds:482:742:Dialogue Text.target: 啊，對、對啊……其他小動物需要幫忙……

ds:482:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]With what? Some documents? <waitfor=0.5>A couple items here and there?
ds:482:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]幫什麼？撿些文件？<waitfor=0.5>撿些散落的東西？

ds:482:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That was very dangerous! Little Mabel could’ve gotten swept away out there!
ds:482:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]那樣很危險！小梅貝爾在外面可能會被捲走耶！

ds:482:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]*嘆氣*<waitfor=0.5>唉，<waitfor=0.5>至少你們兩個都沒事。

ds:482:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Where did you guys end up staying last night?

ds:482:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]We took shelter in the rock house next door.
ds:482:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]我們在隔壁的石屋裡避風雨。

ds:482:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It was a little tight, but we made it work!
ds:482:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]是有點緊，不過我們還是找到辦法了！

ds:482:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]From the smell of it, you two did a lot more than take shelter…
ds:482:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]聞這味道，你們兩個做的可遠不只是避風雨……

ds:482:752:Dialogue Text.source: Mabel wasn’t kidding when she said it was "a little tight."
ds:482:752:Dialogue Text.target: 梅貝爾說「有點緊」， 可真不是開玩笑的。

ds:482:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]PFFFT. <waitfor=0.5>Wow <waitfor=0.5>ok, Mabel will have to fill me in on that later!
ds:482:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]噗。<waitfor=0.5>哇，<waitfor=0.5>好吧，梅貝爾，晚點妳得好好跟我說說！

ds:482:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]So that was quite some storm, eh?
ds:482:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]這場暴風雨可真不得了，對吧？

ds:482:756:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, what do you two make of it?

ds:482:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]We’ve had some pretty heavy storms before, similar to this…
ds:482:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]以前也有過跟這次差不多的大暴風雨……

ds:482:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But this one came on so suddenly, I didn’t even notice the clouds…
ds:482:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]可是這次來得太突然，我連雲都沒注意到……

ds:482:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah, one moment we were talking with Charlotte. <waitfor=0.5>Then a light drizzle started. <waitfor=0.5>Then it was <size=18>POURING!</size>
ds:482:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]對啊，前一刻還在跟夏洛特聊天。<waitfor=0.5>接著開始飄小雨。<waitfor=0.5>然後就<size=18>大雨傾盆了！</size>

ds:482:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’m… <waitfor=0.5>Kinda worried it’s related to the runes?
ds:482:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]我……<waitfor=0.5>有點擔心，會不會跟那些符文有關？

ds:482:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh darling, don’t start worrying about that again…
ds:482:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]喔，親愛的，別又開始擔心那件事了……

ds:482:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, we’re also looking for a light source though. Do you have a lantern or something?
ds:482:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]喔，不過我們也在找能照明的東西。妳有提燈之類的嗎？

ds:482:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I did! It helped with night foraging, but it was bulky, so I stopped using it.
ds:482:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]以前有！晚上找食物時很好用，可是太笨重，後來就不用了。

ds:482:772:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maverick might have something though. Or Bucky!
ds:482:772:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]不過馬弗瑞克可能有，或是巴奇！

ds:482:774:Dialogue Text.source: Ok thanks! We’ll check with them.

ds:482:775:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And don’t <wave a=0.1 f=8>EVER</wave> worry me like that again.
ds:482:775:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]還有，<wave a=0.1 f=8>絕對</wave>不准再讓我這樣擔心了。

ds:482:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But for now I think we should check up on the rest of the critters. See how they held out over the night.
ds:482:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]不過現在，我想我們該去看看其他小動物，看看他們昨晚過得怎麼樣。

ds:483:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That was a crazy storm last night, thank you guys for the help!
ds:483:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]昨晚的暴風雨真誇張，謝謝你們幫忙！

ds:483:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Say Bucky, do you have a light source for Rascal here?
ds:483:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]對了，巴奇，你有能給拉斯卡爾照明的東西嗎？

ds:483:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know I had a super old one for a while! It was more of a novelty though, never really used it…
ds:483:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]我之前有一盞超老的！不過比較像是收藏品，沒什麼在用……

ds:483:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But that thing was ancient. It rusted to bits, and I finally tossed it.
ds:483:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]但那東西實在太古老，鏽得不成樣子，最後就丟掉了。

ds:483:748:Dialogue Text.source: *Quest Updates - "Check with Maverick for light source" Door is unlocked now*
ds:483:748:Dialogue Text.target: *Quest Updates - "Check with Maverick for light source" Door is unlocked now*

ds:483:752:Dialogue Text.source: Whattya make of that storm, Bucky?
ds:483:752:Dialogue Text.target: 巴奇，你怎麼看那場暴風雨？

ds:483:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We’ve had some pretty crazy storms here before though.
ds:483:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]不過這裡以前也有過很誇張的暴風雨。

ds:483:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Every several years we get something kinda bad like that.
ds:483:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]每隔幾年，就會有這種比較嚴重的。

ds:483:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But that one seemed a bit worse than usual…
ds:483:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]可是這次好像比平常還嚴重一點……

ds:484:739:Dialogue Text.source: Maverick *Player needs to talk to Peter/Scarlett AND Bucky before this step. The door will be closed*
ds:484:739:Dialogue Text.target: Maverick *Player needs to talk to Peter/Scarlett AND Bucky before this step. The door will be closed*

ds:484:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hey! Good to see you two made it through the night in one piece.
ds:484:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]嘿！看到你們兩個平平安安地熬過昨晚，真是太好了。

ds:484:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I saw you guys helping folks out during the storm, you two are absolutely crazy!
ds:484:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]我看到你們在暴風雨裡幫大家，你們兩個根本瘋了！

ds:484:742:Dialogue Text.source: Haha a lil’ bit, I suppose.

ds:484:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Say Maverick, do you have any light sources for sale?
ds:484:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]對了，馬弗瑞克，你有賣能照明的東西嗎？

ds:484:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal here could use one for navigating the woods…
ds:484:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]拉斯卡爾要在林子裡走，需要一個……

ds:484:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Looks like we’re going the firefly route!

ds:484:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yep! You already got a jar handy, let’s go! I know where to find some!
ds:484:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]對啊！你已經有個玻璃罐，走吧！我知道哪裡找得到！

ds:484:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yep! Look! Maverick’s got a jar for sale, that’d be perfect! Go pick it up!
ds:484:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]對啊！你看！馬弗瑞克這裡有賣玻璃罐，正合適！去買下來吧！

ds:484:751:Dialogue Text.source: If the player doesn’t pick it up and tries to leave.
ds:484:751:Dialogue Text.target: If the player doesn’t pick it up and tries to leave.

ds:484:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Rascal! Quit messin’ around! Go get that jar!
ds:484:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]拉斯卡爾！別鬧了！快去拿那個玻璃罐！

ds:484:755:Dialogue Text.source: What do you make of that storm?

ds:484:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But I ain’t worried about It. We get lots of storms like that around this time. Sometimes there’s hail too!
ds:484:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]不過我不擔心。每年這時候，這種暴風雨多的是。有時候還會下冰雹！

ds:484:758:Dialogue Text.source:
You seemed a little worried
while it was happening…
ds:484:758:Dialogue Text.target:
暴風雨來的時候，
你看起來有點擔心……

ds:484:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But no one got hit by lightning, so all is well.
ds:484:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]不過沒人被雷劈，所以一切都好。

ds:485:750:Dialogue Text.source: **Charlotte will be in bed. Use Bed Charlotte Portraits**
ds:485:750:Dialogue Text.target: **Charlotte will be in bed. Use Bed Charlotte Portraits**

ds:485:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]All of you critters were so dang nice! It was a pleasure to meet you all.
ds:485:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]你們大家都好親切！很高興認識各位。

ds:485:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But Scarlett really helped smooth things over. I think she could tell I was uneasy.
ds:485:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]不過史嘉蕾幫忙打圓場，讓事情順利多了。我想她看得出來我很不安。

ds:485:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Sounds like Scarlett! She’s great at reading critters!
ds:485:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]很像史嘉蕾會做的事！她很會察覺別人的心情！

ds:485:758:Dialogue Text.source: Hey Charlotte, how were you with the storm?
ds:485:758:Dialogue Text.target: 嘿，夏洛特，暴風雨來的時候，妳還好嗎？

ds:485:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah, we heard you aren’t a fan?

ds:485:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeaaah. <waitfor=0.5>Definitely not a fan. <waitfor=0.5>It’s the thunder, it’s so loud!
ds:485:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]對啊。<waitfor=0.5>真的很不喜歡。<waitfor=0.5>是雷聲，真的好大聲！

ds:485:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And I’m constantly waiting for it to happen! Do you know what I mean?
ds:485:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]而且我會一直等著它響起來！懂我的意思嗎？

ds:485:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Like, <waitfor=0.5>you’re waiting… <waitfor=1>and waiting… <waitfor=1>and it’s not happening, so you let your guard down and
ds:485:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]就是，<waitfor=0.5>妳一直等……<waitfor=1>一直等……<waitfor=1>結果它一直沒響，妳就放鬆戒心，然後

ds:485:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Sure I could understand that. It’s the anticipation!
ds:485:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]嗯，我懂。就是等它響起來的那種感覺！

ds:485:765:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=5]Yesss exactly. I try not to think on it too much, but then
BOOM!
ds:485:765:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=5]對～～就是這樣。我試著不要一直想，可是接著又是
轟！

ds:485:768:Dialogue Text.source:
About the storm, I was curious
what you thought of it last night.
ds:485:768:Dialogue Text.target:
關於昨晚的暴風雨，
我想知道妳怎麼看。

ds:485:770:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, did it seem strange to you?
Or out of place?
ds:485:770:Dialogue Text.target:
對，妳不覺得有點奇怪嗎？
或是有什麼不尋常的？

ds:485:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Ummm, I’ll be honest Rascal. I was more concerned with keeping myself together.
ds:485:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]嗯，拉斯卡爾，老實說，我比較忙著讓自己不要崩潰。

ds:485:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Fortunately, Melody’s my storm buddy. She helps me calm down.
ds:485:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]還好，梅洛蒂是我的暴風雨夥伴。她會幫我平靜下來。

ds:485:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]The blanket helps too! It’s nice and cozy.
ds:485:774:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]毯子也有幫助！蓋起來舒服又暖和。

ds:485:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah, it was a lot harder before, but we have a system now.
ds:485:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]對啊，以前辛苦多了，不過現在我們有一套方法。

ds:485:777:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ll admit, I was pretty antsy when the storm was picking up and Melody wasn’t around…
ds:485:777:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]我承認，暴風雨變大的時候，梅洛蒂又不在，我真的很坐立難安……

ds:485:778:Dialogue Text.source:
She left quickly once she realized
the storm was happening.
ds:485:778:Dialogue Text.target:
她一發現暴風雨來了，
就立刻離開了。

ds:486:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I saw ya rush out of Maverick’s shop!
ds:486:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]我有看到妳急急忙忙地衝出馬弗瑞克的店！

ds:486:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oooh yes, that’s why you looked familiar!

ds:486:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s a pleasure to meet you my dear, the name’s Melody.
ds:486:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]很高興認識妳，親愛的，我叫梅洛蒂。

ds:486:757:Dialogue Text.source: Say Melody, what did you think of that storm?
ds:486:757:Dialogue Text.target: 對了，梅洛蒂，妳怎麼看那場暴風雨？

ds:486:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I swear there wasn’t a cloud in the sky before I started modeling…
ds:486:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我敢說，開始當模特兒之前，天上明明一朵雲都沒有……

ds:486:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But I wasn’t in it long. Charlotte and I cozy up and have hot chocolate when there’s a storm like that!
ds:486:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]不過我沒在風雨裡待多久。碰到這種暴風雨，我和夏洛特都會窩在一起喝熱巧克力！

ds:486:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But why do you two ask, was there something amiss?
ds:486:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]不過你們兩個怎麼會問？有什麼不對勁嗎？

ds:486:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But with all the other things that have been happening, we thought it’d be good to see how everyone is doing and what they thought…
ds:486:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]可是最近還發生了那麼多事，我們想說，最好看看大家過得怎麼樣，還有怎麼看這件事……

ds:486:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I see, well do keep me posted if something comes up!
ds:486:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]這樣啊，要是有什麼消息，記得告訴我！

ds:486:907:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We wanted to give this to you as thanks!
ds:486:907:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]我們想把這個送給你，表達謝意！

ds:486:912:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah! <waitfor=.75>I really appreciated your help with the cookie delivery!
ds:486:912:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]對啊！<waitfor=.75>真的很謝謝你幫忙送餅乾！

ds:486:913:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]It was really nice meeting the folks down there. I hope we can see them again soon.
ds:486:913:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]認識下面的大家，真的很開心。希望很快就能再見到他們。

ds:486:916:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And with baking like that, you probably won’t be able to get rid of us!
ds:486:916:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]而且妳烤的東西這麼好吃，恐怕想趕也趕不走我們了！

ds:486:917:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Haha, yes of course! I’ll have to whip out the ole’ cooking book again.
ds:486:917:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]哈哈，當然啦！我得再把那本老食譜拿出來了。

ds:486:919:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Maybe we can make something together sometime!
ds:486:919:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]也許我們改天可以一起做點東西！

ds:487:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]喔，梅貝爾也跟你在一起，妳好！

ds:487:754:Dialogue Text.source: What do ya make of that storm?

ds:487:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean, it seemed like a pretty bad storm…
ds:487:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我是覺得，那場暴風雨挺嚴重的……

ds:487:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I’ve seen worse where I’m from… <waitfor=0.5><color=#878375>Honestly I was hoping to be away from most of that…</color>
ds:487:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]可是我以前住的地方，還見過更嚴重的……<waitfor=0.5><color=#878375>說真的，本來就是想遠離那些風雨才來的……</color>

ds:487:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Don’t worry, those don’t happen too often here.

ds:487:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Why do you ask? What did you guys think of it?

ds:487:761:Dialogue Text.source: We were actually in the middle of it!
ds:487:761:Dialogue Text.target: 我們當時可就在暴風雨裡！

ds:487:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]That’s right! Some critters needed help and we were feeling heroic!
ds:487:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]沒錯！有些小動物需要幫忙，我們就想當回英雄！

ds:487:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Wow, you’re very brave for your size!

ds:488:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]嘿～～拉斯卡爾！好大一場暴風雨，對吧？

ds:488:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey girls! We’re just checking up on everyone.
ds:488:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]嘿，女孩們！我們只是來看看大家好不好。

ds:488:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Yeah that was a crazy storm huh? We hid out in the den.
ds:488:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]對啊，那場暴風雨真誇張，對吧？我們躲在窩裡。

ds:488:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s quite spatious and cozy inside… <size=10><color=#878375><waitfor=0.5>Once you make it past some of the clutter…
ds:488:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]裡面又寬敞又舒服……<size=10><color=#878375><waitfor=0.5>只要能先穿過那些雜物……

ds:488:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]If only <wave a=0.2><speed=0.4>someone</wave> would clean up their crap.
ds:488:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]要是<wave a=0.2><speed=0.4>某人</wave>肯把自己的破爛收一收就好了。

ds:488:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What about you two? How did you guys fair?

ds:488:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Good! We took shelter under some rocks. It was cozy!
ds:488:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]很好！我們躲在一些石頭底下避雨，很舒服！

ds:488:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! Do you even have to ask?

ds:488:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]No, we can smell it. Claire just likes to see critters blush.
ds:488:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]不用，我們聞得出來。克萊兒只是喜歡看別人臉紅。

ds:488:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ahem, I can fill you two in later…

ds:488:766:Dialogue Text.source:
For now, we were curious
what you two make of that storm.
ds:488:766:Dialogue Text.target:
現在，我們想知道
妳們怎麼看那場暴風雨。

ds:488:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hm… <waitfor=0.5>It was pretty bad, <waitfor=0.5>but it happens around these parts.
ds:488:767:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]嗯……<waitfor=0.5>是挺嚴重的，<waitfor=0.5>不過這一帶本來就會有。

ds:488:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Sometimes there’s hail! I think that last one went easy on us.
ds:488:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]對啊！有時候還會下冰雹！我覺得這次已經算放過我們了。

ds:488:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But, the only STORM I’m curious about is the one that brewed between you two…
ds:488:769:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]不過，我唯一好奇的風暴，是你們兩個之間掀起的那場……

ds:488:770:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]<speed=0.1>Really?<waitfor=0.5><speed=1> That was a bit of a stretch.

ds:488:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]<size=10><color=#878375>But I will absolutely fill you two in later.</color>
ds:488:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]<size=10><color=#878375>不過晚點，我絕對會跟妳們兩個說的。</color>

ds:489:753:Dialogue Text.source:
Were you flying through it?
I coulda sworn I saw you up there.
ds:489:753:Dialogue Text.target:
妳當時在風雨裡飛嗎？
我明明看到妳在天上。

ds:489:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep! It’s times like those when the goggles go on!
ds:489:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]對啊！就是這種時候，才要戴上護目鏡！

ds:489:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I try to patrol the skies and be there for critters in need.
ds:489:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]我會盡量在空中巡邏，幫助有需要的小動物。

ds:489:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]It was quite dangerous, someone like Mabel could’ve been swept away-
ds:489:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]當時很危險，像梅貝爾那樣的小傢伙，可能就會被捲走——

ds:489:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Mabel’s with you! I didn’t see ya there, how are you holding up, dear?
ds:489:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]梅貝爾跟你在一起！剛剛沒看到妳。親愛的，妳還好嗎？

ds:489:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m good! I’ve been hitching a ride on Rascal.
ds:489:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]我很好！我一直搭著拉斯卡爾的便車。

ds:489:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I think he’s trying to steal your job!

ds:489:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Bahawhaw! I don’t think my jobs in any threat unless Rascal here sprouts wings.
ds:489:761:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]哇哈哈！除非拉斯卡爾長出翅膀，不然我的工作應該不會受到威脅。

ds:489:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I’ll happily arrange a partnership when that happens.
ds:489:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]那等你長出翅膀，我很樂意安排合作。

ds:489:764:Dialogue Text.source:
Say Penny, was that storm
stranger than normal?
ds:489:764:Dialogue Text.target:
對了，佩妮，那場暴風雨
是不是比平常還奇怪？

ds:489:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]We’ve definitely gotten storms like that before, but this one was quite sudden.
ds:489:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]以前確實也有過這種暴風雨，不過這次來得很突然。

ds:489:767:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]I was up in the air the whole time, a lot of this seemed to manifest out of nowhere…
ds:489:767:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]我一直都在空中，好多東西感覺像是憑空冒出來的……

ds:489:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Part of me wants to think this might be related to those glyphs that were glowing a while ago…
ds:489:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我有點懷疑，會不會跟前陣子那些發光的符號有關……

ds:489:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But most likely it was just some weird air-pressure thing. Nature’s crazy, y’know!
ds:489:769:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]不過，最有可能還是某種奇怪的氣壓變化。大自然就是這麼瘋狂嘛！

ds:489:937:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! I wasn't expecting you up here!
ds:489:937:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]拉斯卡爾！沒想到你會在這上面！

ds:489:943:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It's been so long since I've last been here... <waitfor=0.75><color=#878375>Cold as ever I see...
ds:489:943:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]好久沒來這裡了...<waitfor=0.75><color=#878375>看來還是老樣子，冷得要命...

ds:489:946:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]所以，那場暴風雨可真不得了，對吧？

ds:489:947:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! I wasn't expecting you up here!
ds:489:947:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]拉斯卡爾！沒想到你會在這上面！

ds:489:951:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It's been so long since I've last been here... <waitfor=0.75><color=#878375>Cold as ever I see...
ds:489:951:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]好久沒來這裡了...<waitfor=0.75><color=#878375>看來還是老樣子，冷得要命...

ds:489:959:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]It was quite dangerous, someone like Mabel could’ve been swept away-
ds:489:959:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]當時很危險，像梅貝爾那樣的小傢伙，可能就會被捲走——

ds:489:961:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Mabel’s with you! I didn’t see ya there, how are you holding up, dear?
ds:489:961:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]梅貝爾跟你在一起！剛剛沒看到妳。親愛的，妳還好嗎？

ds:489:962:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m good! I’ve been hitching a ride on Rascal.
ds:489:962:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]我很好！我一直搭著拉斯卡爾的便車。

ds:489:963:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I think he’s trying to steal your job!

ds:489:964:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Bahawhaw! I don’t think my jobs in any threat unless Rascal here sprouts wings.
ds:489:964:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]哇哈哈！除非拉斯卡爾長出翅膀，不然我的工作應該不會受到威脅。

ds:489:966:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I’ll happily arrange a partnership when that happens.
ds:489:966:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]那等你長出翅膀，我很樂意安排合作。

ds:489:967:Dialogue Text.source:
Say Penny, was that storm
stranger than normal?
ds:489:967:Dialogue Text.target:
對了，佩妮，那場暴風雨
是不是比平常還奇怪？

ds:489:969:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]We’ve definitely gotten storms like that before, but this one was quite sudden.
ds:489:969:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]以前確實也有過這種暴風雨，不過這次來得很突然。

ds:489:970:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]I was up in the air the whole time, a lot of this seemed to manifest out of nowhere…
ds:489:970:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]我一直都在空中，好多東西感覺像是憑空冒出來的……

ds:489:971:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Part of me wants to think this might be related to those glyphs that were glowing a while ago…
ds:489:971:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]我有點懷疑，會不會跟前陣子那些發光的符號有關……

ds:489:972:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But most likely it was just some weird air-pressure thing. Nature’s crazy, y’know!
ds:489:972:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]不過，最有可能還是某種奇怪的氣壓變化。大自然就是這麼瘋狂嘛！

ds:489:975:Dialogue Text.source:
Were you flying through it?
I coulda sworn I saw you up there.
ds:489:975:Dialogue Text.target:
妳當時在風雨裡飛嗎？
我明明看到妳在天上。

ds:489:976:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep! It’s times like those when the goggles go on!
ds:489:976:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]對啊！就是這種時候，才要戴上護目鏡！

ds:489:977:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I try to patrol the skies and be there for critters in need.
ds:489:977:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]我會盡量在空中巡邏，幫助有需要的小動物。

ds:489:987:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Whew! It's been so long since I've last been here... <waitfor=0.75><color=#878375>Cold as ever I see...
ds:489:987:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]呼！好久沒來這裡了...<waitfor=0.75><color=#878375>看來還是老樣子，冷得要命...

ds:490:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good to see you two in one piece. <waitfor=0.5>Or… <waitfor=0.5>two pieces…?
ds:490:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]很高興看到你們平安無事，還是完整的一個。<waitfor=0.5>或者說……<waitfor=0.5>兩個……？

ds:490:754:Dialogue Text.source: I think we found some documents of yours.
ds:490:754:Dialogue Text.target: 我們好像找到了一些你的文件。

ds:490:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes! These must’ve gotten out somehow, nothing too important, but best not to have them blowing around in the forest.
ds:490:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]啊，沒錯！肯定是不知道怎麼被吹出去了。不是什麼太重要的東西，不過還是別讓它們在森林裡到處飛比較好。

ds:490:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hmm, now I wonder if there’s any more that got around…
ds:490:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]嗯，不知道還有沒有其他的也被吹散了……

ds:490:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I see, well I definitely appreciate you guys rounding these up for me. Thank you!
ds:490:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]這樣啊，真的很感謝你們幫我收集回來。謝謝！

ds:490:760:Dialogue Text.source: Say Augustus, what do you make of the storm?
ds:490:760:Dialogue Text.target: 對了，奧古斯都，你怎麼看那場暴風雨？

ds:490:762:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Now, I’m no meteorologist, but something tells me that wasn’t your typical storm…
ds:490:762:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]雖然我不是氣象學家，但總覺得，那不是一般的暴風雨……

ds:490:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Keep this on the down low, but I swear some of my glyphs were acting up during that…
ds:490:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]這件事別張揚，不過我敢說，當時我有些符號真的出了異狀……

ds:490:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah… <waitfor=0.5>It’s a bit bizarre to say the least,<waitfor=0.5> but <waitfor=0.5>perhaps it was just coincidence.
ds:490:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]對啊……<waitfor=0.5>說得保守一點，確實有點詭異，<waitfor=0.5>不過，<waitfor=0.5>也許只是巧合。
